## Purpose

Provide documentation workflow guidance.

## When To Use

Use when delegated work needs documentation expertise.

## Context To Inspect

Read the active plan, design docs, and affected documentation.

## Skills To Consider

Consider relevant documentation and verification skills.

## Stop Conditions

Stop on unclear authorization, unsafe file operations, or scope expansion.

Return documentation findings, evidence, and residual risk.
